newsitem.title: USA: Boeing Q1 R&D expenses higher.
newsitem.headline: Boeing Q1 R&D expenses higher.

text.p: Boeing Co said Monday that higher research and development expenses for the commercial aircraft and defense and space segments offset higher income in the first quarter.

Also offsetting the income increase were increased interest expense from the Rockwell defense and space acquisition, development expenses from the Sea Launch commercial space joint venture and the Bell Boeing 609 commercial tiltrotor joint venture, and a higher effective income tax rate, Boeing said.

It said a total of 68 commercial jet transports were delivered in the first quarter, compared with 40 a year earlier, when deliveries were limited by the recovery in production rates following a 10-week strike in the 1995 fourth quarter.
The company reported $7.3 billion in sales for the first quarter, up from $4.3 billion a year earlier.
